rationale: Genome-wide GeCKO knockout screen in MCF7 breast cancer cells treated with the CDK4/6 inhibitor Palbociclib for two weeks or DMSO, two replicates each (Llanos et al. 2022). GEO deposits only an unrounded transformed-RPKM table; prepare.R recovers the integer reads (each column is raw reads times one constant plus a 0.001 pseudocount; >=99.5% of values become integers) and sets the gene to the symbol before the first '|'. The library has no non-targeting controls. The paper's question: which knockouts let cells escape Palbociclib-induced senescent arrest and keep proliferating? Those guides are enriched after two weeks of Palbo. The authors took genes with >2 fold change and >=3 enriched guides (18 genes) and validated the coagulation-pathway genes F9 and PROZ. The two CTL and two 2W libraries are paired replicate experiments but not paired across conditions, so no pairing term (2 residual df).
